name: Airfoil Design Simulation
description: The task involves predicting the incompressible steady-state two-dimensional velocity and pressure fields around airfoils in a subsonic regime, aiming to maximize the lift-over-drag ratio while ensuring computational efficiency and physics compliance.

cr:input.name: AirfRANS Dataset
cr:input.description: The dataset consists of 2D CFD simulations represented as point clouds defined via the nodes of the simulation mesh. Input variables include positions, inlet velocity, distance to the airfoil, and normals. Each sample corresponds to a simulation using OpenFoam.

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: The output consists of predicted velocity fields (ux, uy), pressure divided by specific mass (ps), and turbulent kinematic viscosity (νt). These predictions are used to compute force coefficients as post-treatments.
